  dotnet verisnap migrate --dry-run --project-directory DIR --legacy-root DIR [--legacy-root DIR ...] [--report FILE]
  dotnet verisnap migrate --capture --project <test-project.csproj> --framework <tfm> --legacy-root DIR [--legacy-root DIR ...] [--report FILE]
